regime_context: The detector shows AI Infrastructure as the clear theme leader (score 1.975, rank 1) with a narrow-but-positive margin over Cybersecurity (1.627); eligible breadth is narrowing at 39% and absorption is low (0.31), so leadership is concentrated but not one-narrative. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate, which is HELPING drawdown control on this market (gate_helps true), so de-risking ineligible/weak-durability themes has real utility even though cross-sectional rank carries no return forecast.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Cybersecurity crowding_z of 1.8 converts into a confirmed leadership handoff — the observable would be Cybersecurity's score falling below AI Infrastructure's by more than 0.5 while its breadth drops under 0.8, which would retire the watch and signal the durability flag was a crowding artifact rather than a structural trend.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank 2 but has the strongest structural profile in the set: durability_bar 0.85 (highest of all eligible themes), hurst_tag 'trend' (persistent, not mean-reverting), and breadth 1.0 (every constituent participating). This is the one theme where the trend-gate shows a durable, broad absolute trend rather than a hot-but-fickle momentum spike. Crowding_z 1.8 is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
evidence: durability_bar 0.85, highest of all eligible names
gate_helps true — trend discipline has drawdown utility on this market
theses.dissent: Crowding_z of 1.8 is the most extended reading in the eligible set; this degree of crowding has historically marked local tops in thematic ETFs, so the entry may already reflect the durable-trend premium.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its own 50-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex (XLE) is rank 4 and eligible with durability_bar 0.68, hurst_tag 'trend' and breadth 0.727, but — unlike the crowded tech leaders — crowding_z is a moderate 0.83. It sits just below the AI/tech cluster in momentum while offering a diversifying trend that is not yet crowded. The trend-gate is positive and this is a non-correlated way to express the durable-trend leg without paying the AI concentration premium.
evidence: energy also appears at rank 6 (Equal-Weight) with trend tag, confirming the sector trend is broad
theses.dissent: Energy momentum has historically been commodity-price-driven and prone to sharp reversals; a durable-trend tag at a cyclical peak does not protect against a supply-driven price break.

falsifier.text: XLE underperforms SPY by more than 6% on a rolling 10-day basis before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is rank 8 but INELIGIBLE (durability_bar 0.13 — essentially no trend persistence) with breadth 0.0, meaning no constituent participation. This is exactly the pattern the absolute-trend gate is designed to screen out: a headline score driven by a single mover with no durable trend behind it. The validated edge is drawdown avoidance via the gate, and this theme fails the gate outright.
evidence: durability_bar 0.13, far below any usable threshold
eligible false — the trend gate rejects it
theses.dissent: Silver miners can gap on sudden precious-metal spikes that momentum detectors miss entirely; avoiding it surrenders exposure to a potential sharp upside surprise.

falsifier.text: SIL closes above its 200-day moving average after 10 consecutive sessions of positive breadth above 0.5 before the check-by date
